dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: Ladies and gentlemen, for your safety, please avoid running or rushing through the vehicle. If the ride gets bumpy, please stay seated whenever possible.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: I'm the conductor of this train. It is my responsibility to maintain a comfortable environment for all passengers...

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: And, in extreme circumstances, to take immediate corrective action against anything that threatens the train's proper operation.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: If that happens, the first thing to do is stay calm.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: Snezhnayan trains have been running across this frozen land for at least four hundred years. We've dealt with just about every situation imaginable, and every conductor is trained for emergencies.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: If it comes to that, please trust our judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: It's no trouble... Please let me know if you need anything.
